G10 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The candidate elements were chosen by the screen designers using accessibility and
H3K27ac, so every element here is already enhancer-like. These marks are separating
functional from non-functional inside a pre-enriched pool. Nothing here says how they
would perform at finding enhancers in unselected genome.
elementChromatinCategory is a discretisation of H3K27ac, CTCF and H3K27me3, which are
entered as columns beside it. It is compact, not independent, and a gain that came
only from it would be a gain from re-binning columns already present.
Bulk K562 marks average over a population. An element that is Polycomb-marked in half
the cells and acetylated in the other half reads as both, and no bulk assay can
separate that from an element carrying both marks in every cell.
H3K4me1 and H3K27me3 come from the benchmark as RPM; H3K4me3 comes from ENCODE
replicated peaks as coverage and signal. The me1-minus-me3 contrast therefore mixes
units and is an ordering device, not a physical ratio. The raw columns are entered
beside it so nothing depends on that contrast alone.
Marks are correlational. A mark that predicts function is not thereby a cause of it,
and this loop has no perturbation of any mark to distinguish the two.
